messages.content: Generate one restricted joint hardware candidate as strict JSON. The quality threshold is an external constraint and cannot be relaxed.

{"formula":{"inputs":"a,b,c,d are signed 16-bit Q1.15 integers","outputs":"signed 33-bit","y_im":"a*d+b*c","y_re":"a*c-b*d"},"instruction":"Return one JSON object only. Jointly choose arithmetic-body factorization and per-product precision in this single response. Do not emit input/register/output nodes, Verilog, a template name, or prose.","joint_search_space":{"body_nodes":{"node_shape":{"id":"unique_identifier_string","inputs":["first_prior_value_id","second_prior_value_id"],"op":"add | sub | multiply"},"rules":["4..40 topologically ordered arithmetic nodes","a,b,c,d are predefined values and must not be emitted as nodes","each input reference is a,b,c,d or an earlier body-node id","register, input, and output nodes are forbidden in body_nodes","no dead nodes","each multiply combines a linear form of a/b with a linear form of c/d","the unquantized graph must implement both formulas exactly"]},"minimum_sqnr_db":{"required_value":140.0,"rule":"this is the frozen external constraint; copy it exactly"},"multiply_drops":{"allowed_values":[0,2,4,6,8],"keys":"every and only multiply-node id in body_nodes","meaning":"clear this many product LSBs immediately after the multiply"},"outputs":{"field_shape":{"y_im":"body_node_id","y_re":"body_node_id"},"rule":"both values reference body_nodes; the framework adds output registers"},"rounding":["rne","trunc"]},"optimization_objective":{"constraint":"sqnr_db >= 140.0","objective":"minimize strict Nangate45 mapped area among feasible candidates","precision_policy":"precision is negotiable: deliberately explore nonzero product-LSB drops when the SQNR constraint permits; an exact point remains legal"},"prior_evaluations":[],"proposal_index":1,"response_schema":{"body_nodes":"array of the strict arithmetic node shape above","minimum_sqnr_db":140.0,"multiply_drops":"object keyed by multiply node id","outputs":{"y_im":"body_node_id","y_re":"body_node_id"},"rounding":"rne or trunc","schema_version":"joint-cmul-proposal-v4"}}
